author: Second Wind
description:
OpenAI has announced the end of Sora, its AI video generation tool, after hemorrhaging money and users. The same week, Warner Bros. released the first trailer for their Harry Potter reboot, and it looks exactly like the successful film franchise that came before it. These two things are more connected than they might appear...
This week Darren Mooney explores the economics of generative AI, why many modern adaptations keep looking identical to their predecessors, and the uncomfortable possibility that we're all getting exactly what we asked for.
